positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationState
positions.frame: What is the current, verified calibration state of the Kestrelwood spectrograph?
positions.why: All three expressions converge on the same directional claim from Quill Ashgrove: the Kestrelwood spectrograph is calibrated at 88.4 MHz and that calibration has been verified against the June reference plates, holding across the full observing band. src-1 delivers this as narrative-style prose report; src-2 and src-3 restate the identical instrument/calibration facts as flat bold-label cataloguing (the FieldLabelCataloguing register read) rather than adding new content — three witnesses to one settled, verified calibration state, no tension between them.
